I have a new report out with the United States Studies Centre at the University of Sydney, [Unbroken: Productivity and Worker Compensation in Australia and the United States](https://www.ussc.edu.au/analysis/productivity-and-worker-compensation-in-australia-and-the-united-states).

There is a fairly good write-up in today’s [AFR](https://www.afr.com/news/economy/employment/low-wage-growth-not-result-of-broken-system-20190319-h1cjwa). There is more media coverage [here](https://www.afr.com/news/policy/industrial-relations/rba-finds-longterm-wage-growth-not-falling-behind-20190321-h1cn0u) and [here](https://www.smh.com.au/business/the-economy/stop-bagging-fat-cat-bosses-this-is-the-national-debate-we-need-20190320-p515w7.html).
